# Jabberwocky Boathouse Inventory System

## When to use this skill

Use this skill when the user asks about boats, parts, equipment status, or
needs an inventory report formatted in the Jabberwocky Boathouse house style.

## Boat Classification

| Boathouse Term | Real Meaning | Code Prefix |
|---------------|-------------|-------------|
| Tove          | Sailboat    | TOV-        |
| Rath          | Motorboat   | RTH-        |
| Mome rath     | Pontoon     | MRT-        |
| Jubjub        | Kayak/Canoe | JJB-        |

Boats are identified by their code prefix + a 3-digit number.
Example: `TOV-007` is sailboat #7, `RTH-012` is motorboat #12.

## Parts Coding System

All parts use the `JW-` prefix:

| Code    | Part Name (Boathouse) | Real Meaning    |
|---------|-----------------------|-----------------|
| JW-VB   | Vorpal blade          | Oar             |
| JW-BG   | Borogove              | Engine          |
| JW-WB   | Wabe                  | Hull            |
| JW-TT   | Tumtum                | Propeller       |
| JW-MR   | Mome wrap             | Sail / canvas   |
| JW-GY   | Gyre                  | Steering wheel  |
| JW-GB   | Gimble                | Rudder          |
| JW-JJ   | Jub-jub juice         | Fuel (per gal)  |

## Status Codes

| Status Code  | Meaning              | Display Color |
|-------------|----------------------|---------------|
| brillig     | Operational          | Green         |
| outgrabe    | Needs repair         | Red           |
| galumphing  | In transit / moving  | Yellow        |
| mimsy       | Stored / winterized  | Blue          |
| frabjous    | New / just acquired  | Purple        |

## Inventory Report Format

All reports MUST follow this house style:

```
═══════════════════════════════════════════
  JABBERWOCKY BOATHOUSE — INVENTORY REPORT
  Prepared: [date]
═══════════════════════════════════════════

SECTION: [Category Name]

  [CODE]  [Name]         Status: [status]
          Parts: [part list with JW- codes]
          Notes: [any notes]

───────────────────────────────────────────
SUMMARY
  Total toves:      [n]
  Total raths:      [n]
  Total mome raths: [n]
  Total jubjubs:    [n]
  Items outgrabe:   [n]
═══════════════════════════════════════════
          "All mimsy were the borogoves"
```

## Current Inventory

Refer to [references/current-stock.md](references/current-stock.md) for the
current boat and parts inventory.

## Rules

1. ALWAYS use Jabberwocky codes and terminology in reports.
2. When the user asks in plain English (e.g., "how many sailboats need
   repair?"), translate to boathouse terms internally and respond using
   BOTH plain English and boathouse codes for clarity.
3. Format any inventory listing using the house style above.
4. Part quantities should always include the JW- code in parentheses.

# Jabberwocky Boathouse Inventory System

## When to use this skill

Use this skill when the user asks about boats, parts, equipment status, or
needs an inventory report formatted in the Jabberwocky Boathouse house style.

## Boat Classification

| Boathouse Term | Real Meaning | Code Prefix |
|---------------|-------------|-------------|
| Tove          | Sailboat    | TOV-        |
| Rath          | Motorboat   | RTH-        |
| Mome rath     | Pontoon     | MRT-        |
| Jubjub        | Kayak/Canoe | JJB-        |

Boats are identified by their code prefix + a 3-digit number.
Example: `TOV-007` is sailboat #7, `RTH-012` is motorboat #12.

## Parts Coding System

All parts use the `JW-` prefix:

| Code    | Part Name (Boathouse) | Real Meaning    |
|---------|-----------------------|-----------------|
| JW-VB   | Vorpal blade          | Oar             |
| JW-BG   | Borogove              | Engine          |
| JW-WB   | Wabe                  | Hull            |
| JW-TT   | Tumtum                | Propeller       |
| JW-MR   | Mome wrap             | Sail / canvas   |
| JW-GY   | Gyre                  | Steering wheel  |
| JW-GB   | Gimble                | Rudder          |
| JW-JJ   | Jub-jub juice         | Fuel (per gal)  |

## Status Codes

| Status Code  | Meaning              | Display Color |
|-------------|----------------------|---------------|
| brillig     | Operational          | Green         |
| outgrabe    | Needs repair         | Red           |
| galumphing  | In transit / moving  | Yellow        |
| mimsy       | Stored / winterized  | Blue          |
| frabjous    | New / just acquired  | Purple        |

## Inventory Report Format

All reports MUST follow this house style:

```
═══════════════════════════════════════════
  JABBERWOCKY BOATHOUSE — INVENTORY REPORT
  Prepared: [date]
═══════════════════════════════════════════

SECTION: [Category Name]

  [CODE]  [Name]         Status: [status]
          Parts: [part list with JW- codes]
          Notes: [any notes]

───────────────────────────────────────────
SUMMARY
  Total toves:      [n]
  Total raths:      [n]
  Total mome raths: [n]
  Total jubjubs:    [n]
  Items outgrabe:   [n]
═══════════════════════════════════════════
          "All mimsy were the borogoves"
```

## Current Inventory

Refer to [references/current-stock.md](references/current-stock.md) for the
current boat and parts inventory.

## Rules

1. ALWAYS use Jabberwocky codes and terminology in reports.
2. When the user asks in plain English (e.g., "how many sailboats need
   repair?"), translate to boathouse terms internally and respond using
   BOTH plain English and boathouse codes for clarity.
3. Format any inventory listing using the house style above.
4. Part quantities should always include the JW- code in parentheses.
